title: Wider, Not Closer

mood.label: Grinding on
mood.summary: A 41: the Iran war widens without moving — the UAE cuts all trade with Tehran, Brent holds above $91, Congo's Ebola is its deadliest ever and 40,000 stay displaced on Flores, while a three-day tariff pause and Seoul's peace call push back.

lines: Two missiles fell near the shipping lanes,
so the Gulf closed its books on Tehran.
Congo has stopped counting in hundreds.
Forty thousand sleep under canvas on Flores.
Someone paused a tariff for three days,
the way you hold a door with your foot.
on a war that stopped in fifty-three.
